extracted.intended_audience: creative marketing and communications professionals, brand and agency leaders, creators and festival attendees
extracted.subtask_description: Promotional and informational page describing the Cannes Lions International Festival of Creativity 2026, its programmes, awards, and opportunities for learning, networking and recognition. Aimed at persuading industry professionals to attend, submit work, and engage with the Festival.

rubrics_metrics.name: Creativity
rubrics_metrics.description: Creativity is a central value celebrated by Cannes Lions — the Festival is 'celebrating creativity' and frames creativity as the primary element of awarded work.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page positions creativity as a core dimension of judged or celebrated work; attendees are invited to 'witness creativity come to life' and the Awards set benchmarks for creative excellence. No explicit scoring scale provided, but creativity is foregrounded as a primary criterion for recognition.

rubrics_metrics.name: Effectiveness
rubrics_metrics.description: Effectiveness is named explicitly as a pillar celebrated by the Festival ('celebrating creativity, effectiveness and innovation').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Work considered for recognition is expected to demonstrate effectiveness (e.g., real-world impact or business outcomes). The page implies that effectiveness, alongside creativity and innovation, informs what the Festival celebrates, though no detailed measurement or scoring guidance is given.

rubrics_metrics.name: Innovation
rubrics_metrics.description: Innovation is listed as a core value the Festival celebrates ('celebrating creativity, effectiveness and innovation').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Innovative concepts or novel approaches to marketing, advertising or communications are highlighted as part of judged excellence. The site does not provide technical thresholds but frames innovation as a substantive dimension of award-worthy work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Global creative excellence (Awards benchmark)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Awards are described as 'where the new benchmark for global creative excellence is set each year.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Entrants and attendees are encouraged to 'watch the work awarded on stage, or make history yourself,' indicating the Awards establish influential standards for the industry. This functions as an overarching evaluative standard: work should meet or raise the global benchmark for creative excellence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Creative Brand Lion criteria: systems, cultures and capabilities
rubrics_metrics.description: The Creative Brand Lion 'recognises the systems, cultures and capabilities that make world-class creative inevitable.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This award specifically evaluates organizational-level attributes (systems, culture, capabilities) that enable consistent world-class creative output rather than individual campaigns alone. The page frames these organizational factors as the focal evaluative dimensions for this new Lion.
